trap.label: be likely
trap.right: She is likely to win the prize.
trap.why: O brasileiro omite o verbo be. Em inglês, é be likely to + verbo base.

opts: It is probable that it will rain.

mcq.why: Evidência presente + causa passada = must have + particípio.

fix.wrong: The belief what money matters is common.
fix.right: The belief that money matters is common.

fix.wrong: He must of taken the bus.
fix.right: He must have taken the bus.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com idea that: “I like (we can walk).”
rewrite.answer: I like the idea that we can walk.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com can't have: “Tom was at home.” (impossível)
rewrite.answer: Tom can't have been at home.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com may: “She might have left.”
